text:
Introduction
This procedure outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must
 be performed on every 5 years Y5 as indicated in the above title block.
 The first draft initiated by Demo substation, Eng. Abd Eltawab Ramadan. The 
 first review at Nov 2007.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence
 with cautions marks surrounding the work area is required.
CB must be
 isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CB is required.
Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the 
 multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)
Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and trip springs.
Tools
and Equipments
Gas moisture
 Tester.
Safety
 Personal Equipment ( helmet, Shoes,....)
Complete tool
 set.
Work to be carried out
Reduce the pressure and determine the operating point, compare with the
 value obtained from the gas pressure curve. if the specified tolerances are
 exceeded reset the densimeter or replace.
Measure the SF6 gas moisture content, the maximum permissible moisture
 content of SF6 gas must not exceed 350 ppmv (parts per million by volume) if
 too high a value of gas moisture is recorded open the circuit breaker and
 replace the adsorbed.

1) ppmv = water content in "parts per million" referred
 to volume (values referred to mass or weight in ppmg can be
 converted with a factor of 8.1)
Prepare new densimeter 
 and seal gasket (10),
Unscrew cable 
 connection,
Unscrew the 4 M8 
 mounting with an Allen wrech,
Remove densimeter,
Remove seal gasket 
 (10).
Insert new seal gasket (10),
For assembly, proceed in reverse order of 
 disassembly,
Check gas pressure and correct adjustment if 
 necessary
